why: GAME_WIRING gains a permission nothing uses: settings.ts is allowed audio/engine, which it does not import -- it reads only the manifest's DEFAULT_VOLUME. The sweep over the real tree stays green under it: an unused entry forbids nothing today, and that is the problem, because it is a standing licence for the next edit to pull the audio ENGINE into a settings module without the review moment the list exists to force. This entry was anchored on hud.ts's identical `['audio/manifest']` line until issue #324 removed that file's volume default and with it its wiring entry; settings.ts carries the same shape and keeps its import, so the assertion moved there rather than being deleted. 1 of 84 in dependency-direction.test.ts: `every GAME_WIRING entry names a real file and an import that file actually makes`; every fixture and the layer-pair coverage test pass either way, because the mutation changes no rule, only the list.
